diagnostics.species_effect: mean held-out C-minus-R3 binary log-loss across all 4126 held-out islands for each focal species
diagnostics.breadth: pilot_presence / 1275 from the frozen pilot species universe
diagnostics.primary_descriptive_association: Spearman rho between pilot prevalence and species-level mean C-minus-R3
diagnostics.direction: positive rho means broader species receive a weaker incremental C advantage
diagnostics.rank_quartiles: sort by pilot_presence then species_index; assign first 20, next 20, next 20, final 19 species; report mean/median C-minus-R3 and negative-species count

mechanistic_context.working_interpretation: if high occupancy breadth saturates the available source pool, source-network topology should add less information for widespread species
mechanistic_context.not_claimed: causal source saturation or a universal unimodal relationship

anti_rescue: species-level diagnostics cannot change the global block-weighted primary status
no species are removed from the frozen 79-species universe
no trait or taxonomic subgroup search is authorized
